summary: End-to-end testing of Traction Labs Agency OS (auth, dashboard, clients CRUD, onboarding wizard with real Claude, AI briefing, AI Client Brain, AI COO, document generation + branded PDF export). Backend pytest suite (12 tests) 100% pass. Frontend E2E happy path 100% pass — login redirect, dashboard stat cards, AI briefing with greeting + next best action, 3-step onboarding wizard producing onboarding-result with AI strategy, client detail tabs (CRM/Brain/Docs), analyze-btn producing brain-result, gen-proposal creating a doc row with PDF download link, and AI COO returning assistant reply in chat.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~670 lines — nearing the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, clients.py, ai.py, documents.py) as more endpoints are added.

CORS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo; fine locally since REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL uses Authorization header, but set an explicit CORS_ORIGINS in .env for production.

PDF endpoint accepts token via ?token= query param — this is convenient for direct download but the token is logged in access logs / referrers; consider a short-lived signed download token if this is exposed publicly.
seed_admin auto-resets the admin password to env value on every startup if it differs — safe for MVP with one admin, but any manual password change via UI would be silently overwritten.
startup uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to lifespan handler in FastAPI for forward compatibility.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed clients/tasks/docs via pytest — cleaned up. E2E flow created a real 'TEST_E2E_HVAC' client (status=onboarding) with AI-generated tasks and a proposal document; left in DB for manual inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Agency OS dashboard is fully functional. Auth uses JWT Bearer in Authorization header (stored in localStorage tl_token). Anthropic key is configured — real Claude calls succeed (briefing ~5s, onboarding ~20s, analyze ~10s, coo ~10s, doc generate ~15s). Use generous timeouts (60-90s) when re-testing AI endpoints. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Demo client 'ABC HVAC' (14 open tasks) plus 'TEST_E2E_HVAC' remain in DB from this run — delete via Clients page if noise.
